name: University of Toronto
description: The University of Toronto is a public research university in Toronto, Ontario, founded in 1827. It has three campuses and is known for medicine, engineering, computer science and the humanities.
whyIncluded: Among the most-searched overseas universities from Singapore in 2025 (KiasuParents, a Singapore parents' website), and its Temerty Faculty of Medicine MD is on the Singapore Medical Council's list.

livingCosts.notes: U of T Student Life 'Living costs in Toronto' 2026 monthly estimates for a student renting off campus (not specific to international students); ranges taken at their midpoint. Housing = rent $1,220-$2,700 (1,960) + hydro $65+ (65) + internet $60-$115 (87.50) + tenant's insurance $30-$50 (40). Food & grocery $350+ (350). Transportation $0-$150 (75). Personal = phone $50-$100 (75) + clothing & shoes $50-$100 (75) + entertainment & other $200 + books & supplies $550/semester (2 semesters over 8 months = 137.50). Months = 8-month academic year (Sep-Apr, two semesters; the page gives monthly figures only). One-off $550 emergency fund excluded.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Applied Science (Engineering)
programmes.notes: 2026-27 full-time international tuition; compulsory = incidental fees C$2,266.83 (UHIP C$948 excluded). Not fixed: fee reports raise engineering international fees for continuing students too. 2024 from 2024-25 Tuition Fee Report (Entering 2024).

programmes.name: Juris Doctor (JD), Faculty of Law
programmes.notes: 2026-27 international JD program fee C$72,790 (charged per academic year, not per course) from the U of T Tuition Explorer fee schedule; compulsory = Year 1 incidental and system access fees C$2,165.31 (C$2,115.31 in Years 2-3). UHIP (C$948) excluded. JD is graduate-entry (3 years). International fee rises yearly (2026-27 Tuition Fee Report: C$76,430 for 2027-28). 2025 from the Tuition Explorer 2025-26 schedule; 2024 from the 2024-25 Tuition Fee Report (Table D, international JD C$66,020; fees not found).

programmes.name: Doctor of Medicine (MD), Temerty Faculty of Medicine
programmes.notes: 2026-27 international Doctor of Medicine tuition C$100,270 from the Planning & Budget 2026-27 Tuition Fee Report (international fee schedule; C$103,280 approved for 2027-28). Compulsory = St. George campus incidental + ancillary fees C$2,535.05 for 2026-27 from the MD Program 'Current Fees' page (Mississauga Academy differs); UHIP excluded. MD is graduate-entry (4 years); international places are limited. 2024 and 2025 from the 2025-26 Tuition Fee Report (C$94,510 for 2024-25, C$97,350 for 2025-26); fees for those years not found.
